tools.name: find_churches
tools.description: Find the nearest Catholic churches to a latitude and longitude, up to 10, with their weekly Mass, confession and adoration times. Give a day, time window or kind to keep only churches with a matching time; each church then shows only its matching times, so use get_church for its full week. A window

tools.name: search_churches
tools.description: Find Catholic churches by words in their name, parish or address, up to 10, best match first. Use this when you have a name rather than a location, and include the city when you know it, since many churches share a name. Results already include the full weekly schedule, so get_church isn't needed fo

tools.name: get_church
tools.description: Get one church and its whole weekly schedule, by the id another tool returned. Covers Catholic churches in the United States, from what parish websites publish, so check the parish website before relying on a time. Times are local to the church: work out 'today' as the weekday where the church is. R
